list: The official 55 trophies as PlayStation publishes them: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden until earned, none online. Names, descriptions and grades cross-checked between the two list sources on 2026-11-20.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies (PS5)
sources.detail: The official list — every name, description and grade — with the share of players who had earned each trophy in launch week, which is where this guide's rarity labels come from.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
sources.detail: The official list again, agreeing with Exophase on every name, description and grade, with the counts PlayStation tracks: 250 stunts, 42 shooting range challenges, 500 choices and the rest.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.detail: The roadmap this guide's stages follow: difficulty 4/10, about 200 hours, one playthrough, the Chapter 1 meditation warning, and what the 100% checklist actually asks.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap
sources.detail: A second full guide, spoiler-free: the story structure, the checklist that unlocks after the story, and prices such as the eight garages at $160,000 in all.

sources.name: EGamers — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements
sources.detail: The list with the hidden split by grade — 27 hidden bronze and 1 hidden gold — and the hardest trophies named: A Long Road above all.

sources.name: games.gg — GTA 6 Trophy List: How to Unlock All Achievements & Trophies
sources.detail: The visible and hidden lists kept apart, the 15 manual save slots and one autosave, and trophy targets set beside the stricter 100% targets.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap: All 55 Trophies
sources.detail: A full roadmap and per-trophy table that agrees with the list above: 4/10 difficulty, about 200 hours, everything offline.

sources.name: Vice City Hustle — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies and Achievements
sources.detail: The list compiled from several guides, with the meditation maths spelt out: 18 spots in 10 locations, and the 100% checklist asking only 15 of them.

sources.name: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements: the full official list
sources.detail: Roadmap notes the others skip: which quest lines are Lucia-only or Jason-only, and the expiring hourglass quests that never touch a trophy.

facts.label: To the platinum, in one playthrough (PowerPyx)
Every trophy is single-player — 0 online trophies
Potentially missable trophy: Positive Mental Attitude, in Chapter 1
There is no mission replay — and no trophy needs one

roadmap.title: Story first, eyes open
roadmap.text: Play the five chapters and the finale in order; every story trophy lands on its own and none can be missed. Two habits pay for the whole run: do the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house the moment Lucia offers it (the one window that closes), and scan every new vehicle and animal you pass, because the discovery counters started yesterday. Keep a manual save at each chapter break — there is no mission replay, and a chapter-start save is the only way back.
roadmap.note: PowerPyx's Step 1, in this guide's words.

roadmap.title: Strangers and their strands
roadmap.text: With the map open, work the stranger strands to their final missions: Andy (Lucia's strand), Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone (Jason's), plus Bret's hunt. Finishing any eight strands earns the silver Strangers & Freaks, and each named character's last mission carries its own bronze. Start chains as they unlock — one source reports story-linked windows on some of them, and starting early costs nothing.
roadmap.note: Quest givers tied to trophies all return in free-roam after the story (PowerPyx).

roadmap.title: Activities and collectibles
roadmap.text: The state's to-do list: gold in all 42 shooting range challenges, a drone race win at all 14 Top Fun locations, 250 stunts, 20 different race wins, Cal's fishing challenge, an arcade game, the bowling alley follow-through, all 18 meditation spots, 3 collectible card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 50 of the 80 challenges, all 52 areas explored and 10 vehicles registered to Scooter Bros. Most of these counters also feed the 100% checklist, so none of the work is wasted.

roadmap.title: Crime and money
roadmap.text: The partner trophies and the take: rob 5 bank vaults and escape, an armored truck, a jewelry store unseen, 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs, then launder $250,000 of marked bills and spend $100,000 across the shops — which is also how the 8 garage properties get bought. Do these after the story, when both characters and the whole map are yours.
roadmap.note: The garages cost $160,000 in all (Push Square) — the spending trophy pays for part of them.

roadmap.title: The checklist and the platinum
roadmap.text: The 100% checklist only appears after the story, but everything you already did counts toward it — and it asks less than the trophies do (300 stunts against the trophy's 250 is the famous exception; meditation asks 15 of 18). Sweep what is left, let the 500th choice land where it lands, and A Long Road closes the list. Vice Got a Price! follows on its own.
roadmap.note: PowerPyx puts the checklist at roughly 60% of everything the game tracks.

watchlist.title: Stranger chains may have story windows — start them early
watchlist.text: One source (TechWiser, relayed by EGamers) reports that the stranger chains behind five hidden trophies have windows tied to story progress. PowerPyx is calmer: every quest giver tied to a trophy is available again after the story. Both can be satisfied the same way — begin each chain when it unlocks and finish strands before pushing the final chapter.

watchlist.title: Hourglass quests expire — and do not matter here
watchlist.text: Plenty of optional missions (black icons, pink letters) vanish if you dawdle, and some fences you sell stolen goods to close for good. Neither touches a trophy or the 100% checklist, so let them go without a second thought.
watchlist.src: GTA Spotter roadmap notes; PowerPyx roadmap (checked 2026-11-20)

watchlist.title: No mission replay — keep a save at every chapter break
watchlist.text: The game holds 15 manual save slots and one autosave, and missions cannot be replayed. A save at the start of each chapter is cheap insurance for the one missable moment and for any story choice you want to see twice.

watchlist.title: Cheats switch trophies off
watchlist.text: Entering a cheat disables trophies and saving for that session. Keep the trophy run clean, and if you want to play with cheats, do it on a separate save.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.rarityNote: 0.00% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026) — nobody finishes a 200-hour list in a day.
trophies.guide: The platinum itself: it asks for nothing of its own, only for the other 54. It pops on its own the moment the last of them lands, so the whole guide is its guide — follow the roadmap stages in order and this is the last thing that happens.

steps.text: Earn the 12 story trophies by finishing the five chapters and the final mission (roadmap stage 1).
Finish the stranger strands and the activity and collectible counters (stages 2 and 3).
Close the crime and money trophies, then the 100% checklist for A Long Road (stages 4 and 5).
The platinum awards itself automatically once all 54 others are earned — no extra action, no hidden condition.

trophies.tips: If the count sits at 54/55 with nothing left on the checklist, a counter trophy is usually one or two short — check the counters in this tracker against PlayStation's targets.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.rarityNote: 100.00% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026) — it is the opening mission.
trophies.guide: The first trophy of the game, for finishing the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It cannot be missed: the story starts here, and the trophy lands as the mission closes.

steps.text: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, from the first scene.
Follow the mission's prompts to the end — there are no optional objectives tied to the trophy.
The trophy pops as the mission completes and the open world begins.

trophies.tips: Take the opening slowly if you like: vehicle and animal discoveries made from here on already count toward the later counters.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.rarityNote: 7.99% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: For finishing Chapter 1. Unmissable as a trophy — but Chapter 1 holds the game's one missable moment inside it: after the main mission Down to Earth, Lucia offers to teach you to meditate at Jason's house. Do that meditation before the chapter ends (see Positive Mental Attitude).

steps.text: Play Chapter 1's missions in order from Gone Fishing onward.
After the main mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning and accept when she offers to meditate on the balcony.
Make a manual save before the chapter's final mission, so the meditation window can be revisited if it was skipped.
Finish the chapter's last mission; the trophy pops at the chapter card.

trophies.tips: The meditation is not marked as a meditation spot in the progress menu, which is exactly why it is easy to walk past — the warning exists so you do not.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.rarityNote: 0.90% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026) — the story is long, and day one is short.
trophies.guide: For finishing Chapter 2, name and asterisks exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Unmissable. Chapter 2 is also where playing as Jason and Lucia together opens up, which the last meditation spot and the partner trophies depend on.

steps.text: Continue the story from Chapter 1's end and work through Chapter 2's mission chain.
Note the mission Coffee Break: both characters playable together unlocks around here, which later trophies assume.
Finish the chapter's final mission; the trophy pops at the chapter card.

trophies.tips: Keep scanning new vehicles as the map opens — Whip It Good's 100 discoveries are painless if they are a habit from the start.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.rarityNote: 0.02% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: For finishing Chapter 3. Unmissable. By now every strand giver and activity type has had a chance to appear, so the roadmap's stage 2 and 3 work can run alongside the story from here.

steps.text: Work through Chapter 3's missions in order.
Begin any stranger strand that unlocks along the way rather than leaving them all for later.
Finish the chapter's final mission; the trophy pops at the chapter card.

trophies.tips: If a strand giver seems to have vanished mid-chapter, do not worry: trophy quest givers become available again later in the story and in free-roam.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.rarityNote: 0.02% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: For finishing Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale. Unmissable. Treat the chapter break as the point of no return for tidiness: strands started, saves made, and the meditation long since done.

steps.text: Work through Chapter 4's missions in order.
Save manually at the chapter break before the endgame begins.
Finish the chapter's final mission; the trophy pops at the chapter card.

trophies.tips: Nothing in Chapter 4 locks a trophy away — the reassurance is PowerPyx's: all trophy-related characters are still there after the story.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.rarityNote: 0.02% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026). It is the list's one hidden gold.
trophies.guide: The gold for finishing the final mission — the list's only hidden gold. Unmissable if you finish the story. The credits are not the end of the run: free-roam continues, and the 100% checklist appears in the progress menu for the first time, with everything you already did counted.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 5 to the final mission.
Complete the final mission; the gold pops as it closes.
After the credits, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion to see the checklist the rest of the roadmap works through.

trophies.tips: Do not start a cleanup sweep before this point expecting the checklist to guide you — it is not viewable until the story is done, though progress counts from the start.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.rarityNote: 2.52% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: A named story mission trophy: finish Breakfast Run. It sits inside the chapter flow, so it arrives on its own as you play the story — there is no separate setup and no way to skip past it.

steps.text: Reach the story mission Breakfast Run in the chapter flow.
Complete the mission's objectives to its end.
The trophy pops on the mission-complete screen.

trophies.tips: Named-mission trophies like this one are the checklist the spoiler shield protects — with the shield on, this row stays hidden until you earn it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.rarityNote: 0.02% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: For completing The Cartel Heist, one of the story's set-piece missions. Unmissable: it is on the chapter path, and the trophy is for finishing it, not for any score, take or approach.

steps.text: Reach The Cartel Heist in the story flow.
Play the heist through to its escape and ending.
The trophy pops on completion, whatever approach you chose.

trophies.tips: Heist practice is not wasted: the free-roam robbery trophies in stage 4 use the same escape habits.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.rarityNote: 0.02% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: For completing the story mission Child's Play. Unmissable, on the chapter path, and awarded for completion alone.

steps.text: Reach the story mission Child's Play.
Complete its objectives to the end.
The trophy pops on the mission-complete screen.

trophies.tips: If you are counting chapters: the mission trophies are signposts, not tasks — if one has not popped, the story simply has not reached it yet.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.rarityNote: 0.02% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: For completing the story mission Headliners. Unmissable and awarded for completion, like every named-mission trophy on the list.

steps.text: Reach the story mission Headliners.
Complete its objectives to the end.
The trophy pops on the mission-complete screen.

trophies.tips: Keep a manual save before big set-piece missions if you like seeing both sides of a story choice — there is no mission replay later.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.rarityNote: 0.02% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: For completing VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. Unmissable. The airport also stars in Catch Me If You Can, the free-roam departure trophy — the mission teaches you the layout that trophy plays with.

steps.text: Reach the story mission VCIA Takedown.
Complete its objectives to the end.
The trophy pops on the mission-complete screen.

trophies.tips: While you are at VCIA for the mission, learn the fences and gates — an unscheduled departure later is easier with the layout in your head.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.rarityNote: 0.02% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: For completing Operation Savage Glory, the last of the named story mission trophies. Unmissable, and the sign that the endgame is close.

steps.text: Reach the story mission Operation Savage Glory.
Complete its objectives to the end.
The trophy pops on the mission-complete screen.

trophies.tips: After this one, the remaining story trophies are the chapter card and the gold finale — everything else on your list is cleanup you control.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.rarityNote: 0.00% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026). Every guide names it the hardest trophy on the list.
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the game by every guide's account — not because any single item is hard, but because the 100% checklist touches almost everything: story, robberies, ranges, races, discoveries and challenges. The mercy is that the checklist asks less than the full game holds (about 60% of everything tracked, per PowerPyx) and less than several trophies ask (300 stunts excepted).

steps.text: Finish the story first: the checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) only becomes viewable afterwards, though earlier progress already counts.
Work the checklist by category — it requires every robbery type, the underwater discoveries, the shooting ranges, the drone races and Bret's quests among its lines.
Use the trophy counters as the stricter target where they differ: 250 stunts for the trophy but 300 for the checklist; 15 of 18 meditation spots suffice here.
When the checklist reads 100%, the gold pops — then only the platinum remains.

trophies.tips: Nothing on the checklist is missable, including the Chapter 1 meditation: the checklist wants 15 spots, so even a skipped first spot cannot block this gold.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.targetLabel: stunts completed — the game holds 397, and the 100% checklist asks 300
trophies.rarityNote: 0.00% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: Complete 250 of the game's stunt jumps — there are 397 in all, so you may skip the worst third. A stunt counts when the jump is landed cleanly; the counter in this tracker is PlayStation's own target, and the checklist will later ask for 300, so keep going past the trophy if you are headed for A Long Road.

steps.text: Find a stunt jump — ramps and marked leaps across Leonida — and take it at speed in a car or on a bike.
Land on the wheels without crashing for the stunt to register; a failed landing does not count.
Repeat across the map: any 250 of the 397 count, so route them by region while exploring for The Goodtime State.
At 250 the silver pops; the counter here tracks you to it, and on to 300 for the checklist.

trophies.tips: A fast bike is the forgiving tool for most jumps: easier to line up, easier to land. Save the awkward jumps for last — you may never need them.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.rarityNote: 0.01% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: Try each of the game's nine activity types once. It asks for a taste of everything, not mastery: the same activities the rest of stage 3 then asks you to finish properly, so this one usually lands on its own while you scout them.

steps.text: Open the map's activity icons and note the types on offer — races, drone races, the shooting range, fishing, arcade games and the rest of the nine.
Play one session of each type; finishing is not required for this trophy, only trying.
When the ninth type has been tried, the bronze pops.

trophies.tips: Do this early: it is a free tour of everything stage 3 will ask of you, and it tells you which activities you enjoy grinding.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.targetLabel: shooting range challenges at gold medal standard, across 12 ranges
trophies.rarityNote: 0.01% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026). Named among the hardest by GamesFuze's list.
trophies.guide: Gold in all 42 shooting range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. It is a skill trophy rather than a grind: each challenge is short, repeatable, and scored on accuracy and time, so the route is practice, not patience.

steps.text: Visit a shooting range and play its challenges once through to learn the scoring — medals are per challenge, not per range.
Replay each challenge until it turns gold: accuracy first, then speed, since misses cost more than seconds.
Work range by range across all 12 so no straggler hides; the counter here tracks golds, not attempts.
The 42nd gold earns the silver.

trophies.tips: If one challenge walls you, move on and come back with fresher eyes — the ranges also appear on the 100% checklist, so the golds are doubly spent.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.targetLabel: Top Fun drone race locations won
trophies.rarityNote: 0.00% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough — you do not need every race or every medal, just a first place on each course.

steps.text: Find a Top Fun drone race start on the map and enter with the drone provided.
Learn the course on a first run, then chase the win: clean gates beat risky shortcuts on most courses.
Repeat at all 14 locations; the counter here counts locations won, not races entered.
The bronze pops on the 14th location's win.

trophies.tips: Drone races are also a checklist line for A Long Road, so these wins are never wasted effort.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.targetLabel: different races won — repeats of the same race do not add up
trophies.rarityNote: 0.01% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different is the operative word, so one favourite track farmed twenty times earns nothing. Spread across the map's race series and take a win in each.

steps.text: Enter a race from the map and win it; note which series and course it was.
Move to a new course for the next win rather than replaying the same one.
Keep a spread across vehicle classes — the wins count across all of them.
The 20th distinct win earns the bronze.

trophies.tips: Bring a car suited to the course rather than your fastest overall: off-road races punish a supercar more than traffic does.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.rarityNote: 10.57% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026) — the second most-earned trophy of launch week, because it comes early.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal, the game's fishing hand, in a one-off fishing challenge. It is a single contest, not a counter: find Cal, accept the challenge, and out-fish him once.

steps.text: Meet Cal through the fishing activity as it opens up around the coast and the lakes.
Accept his fishing challenge when it is offered.
Fish the challenge out — steady catches beat one heroic fish — and finish ahead of Cal.
The bronze pops when the challenge is won.

trophies.tips: If you lose, it is a challenge, not a story beat: it can be taken again, so there is nothing to miss here.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.rarityNote: 1.11% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — one, not the whole cabinet row. Find an arcade machine in the world, pick the shortest game on it, and play it to its end.

steps.text: Find an arcade cabinet in a bar or arcade in Vice City and interact with it.
Choose a game and play a full session to completion rather than quitting mid-game.
The bronze pops when the game ends.

trophies.tips: This is also one of the nine activity types Master of None wants you to try, so it does double duty.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.rarityNote: 0.01% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger strand — his last mission, not his first. Andy's chain is Lucia's: play it as Lucia when it offers. Like every strand trophy, it also counts toward the eight strands Strangers & Freaks wants.

steps.text: Meet Andy where his strand icon appears and take his first mission as Lucia — his line is one of the character-locked ones.
Work through each mission his strand offers as new ones unlock.
Complete the strand's final mission; the bronze pops with it, and the strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.tips: Start the chain when it unlocks rather than banking it: one source reports story-linked windows on some stranger chains, and early costs nothing.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.rarityNote: 0.01% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger strand at its final mission. Kenton can be temporarily unavailable during parts of the story — PowerPyx is explicit that he, like every trophy quest giver, comes back, so a missing icon is a pause, not a loss.

steps.text: Meet Kenton at his strand icon and take his first mission.
Continue the strand as its missions unlock; if Kenton vanishes mid-story, push the story and check back.
Complete the final mission of his strand; the bronze pops, and the strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.tips: Kenton is the named example in PowerPyx's reassurance about quest givers — his strand cannot be lost, only delayed.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.rarityNote: 0.02% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger strand at its final mission. One more of the eight strands the silver wants, with its own bronze at the end of the chain.

steps.text: Meet Billy at his strand icon and take his first mission.
Work the strand through as its missions unlock.
Complete the final mission; the bronze pops, and the strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.tips: Strand missions arrive in waves — if no next mission shows, another strand or a story beat usually opens it.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.targetLabel: stranger mission strands completed in full
trophies.rarityNote: 0.00% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: The silver over the whole strand system: finish eight stranger strands end to end. The named strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret — carry their own bronzes at their finales, so this silver is mostly earned by collecting those, plus two more strands of your choosing.

steps.text: Pick up stranger strands from their map icons as they appear across Leonida.
Finish strands in full — a strand counts when its final mission is done, not when it is started.
Count the named ones first (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret), then add any two further strands to reach eight.
The eighth completed strand earns the silver.

trophies.tips: Some strands are character-locked — Andy is Lucia's; Tyrone and Bret are Jason's — so swap characters when an icon will not start.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.rarityNote: 0.01% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger strand at its final mission — one of the eight strands, with its own bronze at the end.

steps.text: Meet Randy at his strand icon and take his first mission.
Work the strand through as its missions unlock.
Complete the final mission; the bronze pops, and the strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.tips: If two strands compete for your attention, finish the one closest to its finale — the silver counts completed strands only.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.rarityNote: 0.01% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger strand at its final mission. Tyrone's line is Jason's, per GTA Spotter's roadmap notes — bring the right character to the icon.

steps.text: Meet Tyrone at his strand icon as Jason and take his first mission.
Work the strand through as its missions unlock.
Complete the final mission; the bronze pops, and the strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.tips: Character-locked strands are the usual reason an icon seems broken — it is waiting for the other protagonist.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: The first meditation is offered once, in Chapter 1: after the main mission Down to Earth, Lucia meditates on the balcony at Jason's house and invites you to join. Once Chapter 1 ends, that moment is gone. Whether the trophy's 18 spots include it is unconfirmed — PowerPyx's author did it and earned the trophy, so do it. Reported by PowerPyx and GTABase; the 100% checklist asks only 15 of 18 spots, so A Long Road is safe either way.
trophies.targetLabel: meditation spots used, in 10 locations across Leonida
trophies.rarityNote: 0.01% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots, spread over 10 locations, using both Jason and Lucia — the last spot needs the two of them together, which only opens after Chapter 2. It is the list's one potentially missable trophy, and only because of where its first spot hides: inside a Chapter 1 story moment, not on the map.

steps.text: In Chapter 1, after the main mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning and accept when she goes to the balcony to meditate — this is the spot that disappears when the chapter ends.
From then on, use every meditation spot you find marked across Leonida; there are 18 spots in 10 locations.
The final spot requires Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2 — save it for then.
At 18 spots the bronze pops; the counter here tracks the spots as PlayStation counts them.

trophies.tips: Missed the balcony moment? All is not lost: it is unconfirmed whether that meditation is one of the 18, and the 100% checklist only asks 15 — but a fresh Chapter 1 save is the only certain cure, which is why the roadmap saves at every chapter break.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.rarityNote: 0.01% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: Bret's strand is the hunting line, and this bronze is for the unique animal at its heart: one specific beast Bret sends Jason after, not any animal of its species. Bret's quests are also on the 100% checklist, so the hunt is never wasted.

steps.text: Meet Bret as Jason and take his hunting missions as his strand opens.
Work Bret's quests until he names the unique animal and its ground.
Track and hunt that unique animal, and bring the hunt back to Bret.
The bronze pops when Bret's hunt is complete.

trophies.tips: Study animals as you travel from stage 1 onward — Bret's later quests and the checklist both lean on the animal log you build.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.rarityNote: 0.00% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: The collectible cards hide in sets; complete any three full sets. A set counts when its last card is picked up, so the efficient hunt finishes sets rather than scattering single cards across all of them.

steps.text: Pick up every collectible card you pass — they sit in the world like other collectibles, and the game tracks them by set.
Check which set is closest to complete and hunt its missing cards first.
Finish a full set; repeat until three sets are complete.
The third completed set earns the silver.

trophies.tips: Cards pair naturally with The Goodtime State's exploration: sweep a region for its cards while you are there revealing it.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.rarityNote: 0.00% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK spots at 100 different locations. Like the meditation spots, these are fixed places in the world; the counter only moves at a location you have not used before, so it is a tour of Leonida disguised as a joke trophy.

steps.text: Find a WAiNK location — they are marked in the world as you explore — and use it.
Move on: a location counts once, so route new ones into every trip across the map.
Keep the counter here honest against PlayStation's target of 100.
The 100th new location earns the silver.

trophies.tips: Combine the hunt with stunt jumps and card sets region by region — three counters climb on the same drive.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.targetLabel: challenges completed — the game holds 80, in eight groups of ten
trophies.rarityNote: 0.00% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges, which come in eight groups of ten. The trophy takes 50; the 100% checklist will later ask 70, so choose challenges you can also imagine finishing for the checklist's sake.

steps.text: Open the challenges in the progress menu and pick a group whose tasks suit how you play.
Complete challenges one by one; each finished challenge counts once toward the 50.
Spread across groups when one group walls you — any 50 of the 80 count.
The 50th completed challenge earns the bronze.

trophies.tips: Many challenges complete themselves in the background of other trophies — check the list before grinding one the slow way.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.rarityNote: 0.19% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: A two-character trophy: with your partner beside you, raise a four-star wanted level and then lose it completely. Both halves matter — the stars must reach four with your partner present, and the escape must be clean.

steps.text: Play with Jason and Lucia together — the partner setup unlocks after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
With your partner with you, cause enough trouble to reach a 4-star wanted level.
Break line of sight and hide until the stars drain away entirely.
The bronze pops when the wanted level is fully lost with your partner still with you.

trophies.tips: A vehicle swap away from the search zone is the reliable escape: ditch the hot car, take a clean one, and stay out of sight until the stars blink out.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.rarityNote: 0.02% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner while keeping a wanted level alive the whole time: the chain breaks if the stars fully drain between shops, so this is a route-planning trophy — three close shops, one fast car, no hiding.

steps.text: Pick a cluster of three shops near each other and park a fast car outside the first.
With your partner, rob the first shop and keep moving while the wanted level is active.
Rob the second and third shops back-to-back, never letting the stars fully disappear in between.
The bronze pops on the third robbery; escape afterwards however you like.

trophies.tips: Distance is the enemy, not the police: the closer the three shops, the less time the wanted level has to fade.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.targetLabel: different vehicles discovered — get in, and the game logs it
trophies.rarityNote: 1.02% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles: a vehicle is discovered when you get into it, and the game logs each model once. It is the easiest counter to finish early if it is a habit from stage 1 — every new car you pass is one more.

steps.text: From the opening onward, get into every vehicle model you have not driven before, even just to move it.
Watch richer areas for rarer models: marinas, airports and wealthy districts carry what the highway does not.
The counter here tracks PlayStation's target of 100 discoveries.
The 100th discovered vehicle earns the bronze.

trophies.tips: PowerPyx's Step 1 advice is exactly this: scan vehicles during the story, and the trophy is finished before it ever feels like a task.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.rarityNote: 0.07% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: One use of Combat Focus — the slow-motion gunplay ability — must drop five enemies. The trick is the setup, not the shooting: you need five enemies alive, in reach, and a full ability ready before you trigger it.

steps.text: Find a fight with at least five enemies grouped in one area — a gang operation or a robbery gone loud both work.
Weaken your position deliberately little: enter with Combat Focus charged and a high-capacity weapon equipped.
Trigger Combat Focus once and take down five enemies before it ends — do not let the ability lapse between kills.
The bronze pops on the fifth takedown inside that single use.

trophies.tips: If the fifth enemy is always out of frame, start the ability facing the group's middle, not its edge.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.rarityNote: 0.18% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, leave in a way the airport did not schedule: take a plane that was never yours to take. The story's VCIA Takedown teaches the layout; this trophy is the free-roam version of the same joke.

steps.text: Head to VCIA in free-roam and get airside — the mission Hi-Jacked showed you the ways in.
Take an aircraft on the field and get airborne with it.
The bronze pops as your unscheduled departure leaves the ground.

trophies.tips: Expect a wanted level for your trouble; the trophy lands on takeoff, so the escape afterwards is your own business.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.rarityNote: 0.17% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: The description is the whole official hint: the Rhino is the game's tank, and this hidden bronze is about getting into one. Rhinos appear when the heat is at its highest — or where the military keeps them.

steps.text: Raise your wanted level to the top end and wait for the military response, Rhinos included — or find where armor is stationed.
Reach a Rhino and get inside it; pulling its driver out at a standstill is the survivable way.
The bronze pops once you are in the hot seat the description jokes about.

trophies.tips: Go in with full health and an escape vehicle nearby: everything on the field will be shooting at the person stealing the tank.

trophies.name: It's Not An Office
trophies.rarityNote: 0.03% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: The smallest trophy on the list: take a bath. Safehouses have bathrooms; when the bath is offered as an interaction, take it, and the game does the rest.

steps.text: Go to a safehouse bathroom — Jason's house is the first one you own.
Use the bath when the interaction prompt appears.
The bronze pops as the bath is taken.

trophies.tips: File this with the game's other domestic jokes: several hidden bronzes are one interaction deep, so try the furniture in every new safehouse.

trophies.name: I Swear, By My Pretty Floral Bonnet, I Will End You
trophies.rarityNote: 0.01% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: Bust open five bank vaults — the full robbery, down to the vault itself, five times. Bank jobs are also a robbery category the 100% checklist requires, so these five count twice.

steps.text: Scope a bank and start its robbery in free-roam.
Push through to the vault and bust it open rather than settling for the tills.
Escape and repeat at other banks until five vaults are opened; the counter here tracks them.
The fifth vault earns the bronze.

trophies.tips: Bring your partner and a planned exit: a vault job earns a serious wanted level, and the escape is the real challenge of each repeat.

trophies.name: All Dolled Up
trophies.description: Take a ride on the Port Gellhorn ferris wheel.
trophies.rarityNote: 0.01% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: Ride the ferris wheel at Port Gellhorn. One ride, start to finish — the trophy is for being a tourist, and Port Gellhorn is worth the trip anyway for its exploration credit.

steps.text: Travel to Port Gellhorn and find its ferris wheel on the waterfront.
Board the wheel when the interaction appears.
Ride it through; the bronze pops as the ride completes.

trophies.tips: While you are in Port Gellhorn, clear its area discovery and any local collectibles — one trip, several counters.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.rarityNote: 0.02% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: Discover every area of Leonida — all 52 of them. An area is discovered by entering it, so the silver is a full tour: every district, island and backwater on the map, including the ones the story never visits.

steps.text: Play the story and let it reveal the map's spine — the chapters carry you through most regions once.
Afterwards, sweep the map region by region for the areas still dark; the counter here tracks the 52.
Take a boat and a plane for the coasts and islands a car cannot reach.
The 52nd discovered area earns the silver.

trophies.tips: Do this sweep with the collectible counters open: stunts, cards and WAiNK spots all live in the same unexplored corners.

trophies.name: War and Peas
trophies.description: Take out a leader of each gang in Leonida.
trophies.targetLabel: gang leaders taken out — one for each of Leonida's nine gangs
trophies.rarityNote: 0.01% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: Take out the leader of each of Leonida's nine gangs — one leader per gang, nine in all. Gang operations surface their leaders as you work the territories, and Bret's hunting skills are good rehearsal for the approach work.

steps.text: Find a gang's operation in its territory and work it until its leader is exposed.
Take the leader out; the counter here tracks gangs, not bodies.
Repeat across all nine gangs of Leonida.
The ninth gang's leader earns the bronze.

trophies.tips: Gang territories overlap other cleanup — leaders are easiest to reach while you are already in the area for exploration and robberies.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.description: Steal a rival gang's drug stash by boat.
trophies.rarityNote: 0.12% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: A story-adjacent trophy: during the game's boat work, steal a rival gang's drug stash by boat rather than letting the moment pass. It belongs to the story's early water missions, so the roadmap files it in stage 1 — play the water sections thoroughly and it lands.

steps.text: Play the story into its boating sections, where the gangs move product by water.
When a rival gang's drug stash is on the water, take it by boat instead of leaving it.
The bronze pops as the stash is stolen.

trophies.tips: Hidden and story-adjacent is exactly what the spoiler shield exists for — it stays covered in the tracker until you earn it.

trophies.name: Hoodwinked
trophies.description: Trick a cop into busting a rival gang member instead of you.
trophies.rarityNote: 0.01% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: A misdirection trophy: with police attention on you, arrange for a rival gang member to be the one busted. It needs all three actors in one place — you, a cop, and a rival — and the rival closer to the cop's hands than you are.

steps.text: Find rival gang members and draw police attention in their presence — a minor crime near both works.
Position yourself so the rival is between you and the responding cop, then break off.
Let the cop take the rival down instead of you; the bronze pops on their bust.

trophies.tips: If the cop keeps choosing you, lower your own profile: stop committing crimes in view and let the rival's resistance draw the arrest.

trophies.name: All Rise
trophies.description: Pull off a police station break out.
trophies.rarityNote: 0.75% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026) — early players found it fast.
trophies.guide: Break someone out of a police station — get in, get them out, and get clear. It is one of the free-roam set pieces the story's heist skills rehearse, and at 0.75% it is one of launch week's most-earned hidden bronzes.

steps.text: Go to a police station in free-roam and find the way to its cells.
Free a prisoner and start the breakout.
Fight or slip out and lose the wanted level that follows; the bronze pops with the breakout pulled off.

trophies.tips: Park the escape car before you go in, not after — the breakout's hardest seconds are the first ones outside.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Strike 3 people with one bowling ball.
trophies.rarityNote: 0.01% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: The title is the series' oldest joke; the requirement is literal. One bowling ball, thrown once, must strike three people. A crowded lane area and a line of three bystanders is the whole setup.

steps.text: Go to a bowling alley and pick up a ball.
Wait or arrange for three people to stand in one line of throw.
Throw the ball once through all three; the bronze pops on the third strike of the same throw.

trophies.tips: Patience beats herding: lanes refill with groups on their own, and a natural line of three is easier than a manufactured one.

trophies.name: What A Choice
trophies.rarityNote: 0.01% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: The list's odd one out: a bronze wired to PSN Profiles, the community site, rather than to the game disc. Make 500 choices there — the community's game-choice polls and picks — and the trophy is earned outside the game entirely. It is why the sources register in this guide leads with the trophy sites themselves.

steps.text: Create or sign in to a PSN Profiles account and link your PSN ID.
Make choices in the site's choice features; each choice counts toward the 500.
Keep the counter here against PlayStation's target of 500 choices.
At 500 choices the bronze unlocks for your linked account.

trophies.tips: Start this on day one and do a few choices whenever you check a rarity — 500 is a marathon that never needs a sprint.

trophies.name: No Horse Play
trophies.description: Win a horse race bet at the OTB.
trophies.rarityNote: 0.01% of players on Exophase had earned it in launch week (checked 20 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: Win one horse race bet at the off-track betting shop. One winning ticket is the whole trophy — the amount does not matter, so bet small and often rather than large and rarely.

steps.text: Find the OTB in Vice City and open its race card.
Place a small bet on a horse to win.
Repeat with small bets until one ticket wins; the bronze pops on the first winning bet.
